q2_gaps: definite (specificational / identificational) predicate nominal — 'Neap tides are THE small tides' asserts an identity between two classes, i.e. the small tides are exactly the neap tides; the instruction set only offers the one-directional Inheritance property predication, so the definite article's exhaustiveness is silently lost
notes: The non-fusing split of the size modifier ('small tide' = incidental description) and the definitional 0.99 confidence are both correct. The modifier genus (Inheritance neap_tide neap) is borderline: 'neap' passes the predication test but is not a gradable, positional/cardinal or material adjective, the three categories the exposure rule enumerates.
